{{Quote|Arroo!&raquo;<br />&laquo;Whazzat?&raquo;<br />&laquo;It's only me. This party is great fun, isn't it?|translated=1|Teebo and Wicket W. Warrick in costume on Halloween|<ref name="CCK" />}}
'''Halloween''', or '''Hallowe'en''', was a festival held in certain locations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. For the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the festival entailed decorating the [[temple]] with carved [[Pumpkin/Legends|pumpkins]] and cobwebs. For the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of Endor, the festival was an [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] highlight characterized by revelry, costuming, laughter, and a large feast. During the Halloween of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a [[Diet/Legends|predatory creature]] known as a [[hanadak]] attacked Bright Tree Village but was coaxed into leaving when [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] and other Ewoks placed pacifying [[Dlock plant|blue dlock]] leaves upon it. Later during that same Halloween, a band of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] kidnapped the Ewoks' leader, [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], but Warrick and his friends [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]] rescued the chief and allowed the Halloween festivities to continue.

==Description==
Halloween,<ref name="CWA" /> also spelled ''Hallowe'en'', was an [[Standard year/Legends|annual]]<ref name="CCK" /> festival celebrated by the citizens of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="CWA" /> and the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of<ref name="CCK" /> [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]<ref name="EGC" /> on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. During the festival, revelers dressed in costumes. For instance, Ewoks dressed as [[Ghost (folklore)/Legends|ghosts]] or other creatures, such as [[hanadak]]s. The Ewoks also held a party with a large feast, rollicked through the forest, and scared one another. Halloween decorations included [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Pumpkin/Legends|gourds]] with faces<ref name="CCK" /> or other symbols carved into them, and cobwebs.<ref name="CWA" /> The Ewoks considered Halloween to be one of the best events of the year.<ref name="CCK" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
[[File:Halloween-CWAdventures.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Halloween decorations at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant celebrated Halloween at least once. For the festival, carved pumpkins and cobwebs decked the halls. Some pumpkins featured the likenesses of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]; his enforcer, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]; and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]; others featured the insignia of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Another decoration featured a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] propped up and dressed like a [[Scarecrow/Legends|scarecrow]].<ref name="CWA" />

Meanwhile, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] wandered about in masks and costumes. Among the masks available to visitors were [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], Grievous, a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], a golden [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], a blue [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] wandered about in shiny, gold [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] or were decorated like [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletons]] that wielded scythes. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knights dressed in [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gear. A [[Purple Fur Wampa Suit|purple-furred wampa]], a pink [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]], and a green [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] costume were also available. Even [[Droid/Legends|droids]] dressed up; protocol droids wore masks and fake arms to appear like General Grievous, and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] wore [[Astromech Ghost Costume|sheets]] over their domes to appear like ghosts.<ref name="CWA" />

===The Forest Moon of Endor===
{{Dialogue|Kneesaa|line1=trans|Look at that. Someone's dressed up as a Hanadak.|Teebo|line2=trans|I wonder who it is.|Wicket W. Warrick|line3=trans|Danger! That's no fancy-dress costume. That's a real Hanadak. Look at the fangs.|attr=Kneesaa, Teebo, and Wicket W. Warrick discover a real hanadak loose in the village|src=<ref name="CCK" />}}
On the Halloween of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="Date">"[[Chief Chirpa Kidnapped!]]" takes place concurrently to the rest of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]]. {{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of that series to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], the Ewoks [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] noticed what appeared to be a hanadak, a savage [[Diet/Legends|predator]], in their village. At first they dismissed it as another Ewok in costume, but, upon closer inspection, they found that it was the genuine article. Warrick led a group of Ewoks to drive the creature from the village, but the hanadak repelled their assault. Warrick then led the Ewoks in covering the hanadak in the leaves of the [[Dlock plant|blue dlock]], a pleasant-smelling [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. The leaves soothed the beast, which retreated back into the forest.<ref name="CCK" />

During that same year's Halloween, a group of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] took advantage of the Ewoks' preoccupation with their Halloween party to raid the village's [[Harvest store|storehouse]]. There, they accidentally stole away with not only foodstuffs but also [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], leader of the Ewok village. Kneesaa, Teebo, and Warrick discovered that Chirpa was missing and followed the Duloks' tracks into the woods. Warrick sneaked up behind the Ewok leader, cut him free of his [[Rope/Legends|bonds]], and allowed the chief to [[Skirmish on Halloween|fight]] off the Dulok brigands. The Ewoks returned to their village, and the Halloween festivities continued.<ref name="CCK" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Aren't you a little short for a stormtrooper?|Mon Mothma, upon seeing toddler Luke Skywalker in his stormtrooper Halloween costume|<ref name="DV&S">''[[Darth Vader and Son]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Halloween-DarthVaderAndSon.png|thumb|right|250px|Luke Skywalker goes trick-or-treating.]]
The holiday of Halloween&mdash;spelled ''Hallowe'en''&mdash;originally appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story "[[Chief Chirpa Kidnapped!]]," published in [[1988]] as part of the ''[[Ewoks Annual]]'' from [[Marvel Comics]].<ref name="CCK" /> Over twenty years later, the online [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] featured a Halloween theme from [[October 24]] to [[November 11]], [[2011]]. The Jedi Temple in which much of the game takes place was decorated, and players had the opportunity to purchase masks of ''[[Star Wars]]'' characters and species, costumes, Halloween decorations, and two Halloween-themed droids, [[K-3RNL]] and [[J-4CK]]. The game also featured a special stage of "Rocket Rescue," in which the player controls the astromech droid [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in a ghost costume.<ref name="blog">{{WebCite|url=http://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1060|text=Tricks and Treats!!|work=Intergalactic News|archivedate=20111223063014}}</ref>

Both the Ewok Halloween and the Jedi Temple version bear much similarity to the real-world holiday of [[Wikipedia:Halloween|Halloween]], which is also spelled "Hallowe'en."<ref name="MW">{{WebCite|url=http://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hallowe%27en|text=Halloween - Definition and More from the Free Merriam-Webster Dictionary|work=Merriam-Webster Online|archivedate=20100409022427}} &mdash; the real-world Halloween includes costumes and Jack-O-Lanterns, both of which appear in ''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' and "Chief Chirpa Kidnapped!".</ref> The real-world version appears in the non-[[canon]] children's book ''[[Darth Vader and Son]]'', written and illustrated by [[Jeffrey Brown]] and first published in [[2012]]. In the book, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] takes his son, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], trick-or-treating to the home of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] leaders [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]]. The book's setting is nebulous, as scenes such as this one seem to take place in the real-world as opposed to the ''Star Wars'' universe.<ref name="DV&S" />
